nodes.name: Approval event received
nodes.notes: Signed with X-NexusFlow-Timestamp / X-NexusFlow-Signature (HMAC-SHA256 of '<ts>.<raw body>').

nodes.name: Post to channel
nodes.notes: Channel payload only: never contains the approval token.

nodes.name: Report to NexusFlow
nodes.notes: Full response + never error: downstream nodes branch on statusCode.

nodes.name: Approval decision relay
nodes.notes: Signed with X-NexusFlow-Timestamp / X-NexusFlow-Signature (HMAC-SHA256 of '<ts>.<raw body>').

nodes.name: Submit decision
nodes.notes: Token goes in the URL path; the body is HMAC-signed so the API knows n8n relayed it.

meta.description: Governance agent events. approval.requested: builds the interactive approval card (Slack/Discord/generic) and a private approver payload holding the single-use token; approval.finalized: formats the outcome. The shared channel never receives the token. A second, signed webhook relays an approver's decision to POST /api/v1/approvals/{token}/action. Note: like any value n8n delivers, the token is kept in n8n execution data until EXECUTIONS_DATA_MAX_AGE prunes it.
